svg.text: Somali Mobile Money - source data model (ERD)
MySQL database somali_wallet_source | 10 tables | 64 columns | from the Data Dictionary v1 (24 Oct 2026) | arrows run from foreign key (child) to primary key (parent)
The people who own the wallets. Adds name and home
Generator settings and observation window, stored as
one JSON document. Not linked to other tables.
Wallet register with each wallet's balance at the
start of the period. Parent of every wallet
Wallet balances at the closing cutoff. Opening
balance + ledger movements = closing ledger balance.
A customer's intent to send money to another wallet.
One logical payment; retries keep the same
Money movements of successful attempts: one debit
for the sender and one credit for the recipient,
Each execution try of a payment (up to 3), with the
sender's available balance when the try started.
Every received copy of a payment state event
Lookup of the failure / uncertainty codes on events,
and whether a retry is allowed after failure.
